description: Validates a workflow chart without saving or running it -- the same structural validation and lint as POST /api/v2/workflows/validate, minus the checks that need a specific app. Returns {valid, errors, warnings, workflows_to_create}. `errors` block saving/publishing and must be fixed; `warnings` are likely mistakes worth reviewing. Each issue has a `path` into the chart document (e.g. states.create.on.success.0.target) and a `message`. A `workflow` state calling a child workflow not listed in `known_workflows` is reported as a warning, and its key is listed in `workflows_to_create`: that workflow must exist and be published in the app before this chart can be published.

chart.description: The chart document to check (the JSON object with version, key, states, ...). A JSON-encoded string of it is also accepted.

known_workflows.description: Keys of workflows that already exist in the target app and that this chart may call from `workflow` states. Calls to other keys are reported as warnings.

name: validate_workflow_chart

path.description: Where in the chart document the problem is, e.g. states.create.on.success.0.target (an empty string means the document as a whole).
